title: Accounts per type
statementMd:
Count accounts of each type.

Expected columns: `type`, `accounts`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM accounts GROUP BY type;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
